verses.text: Then Bildad, from the Shuah area, spoke to Job. He said,
“Job, how much longer will you talk like this?
Almighty God certainly never does [RHQ] what is unfair/unjust.
So, it is evident that your children have sinned against him,
But, if you will now earnestly request [DOU] Almighty God to help you,
and if you are pure and honest/righteous,
And even though you think that you were not very prosperous/wealthy before,
“I request you to think about what happened long ago
It seems as though we were born only yesterday
So, why do you not allow your ancestors to teach you and tell you something?
Papyrus can certainly not [RHQ] grow in places where there is no marsh/swamp;
If they do not have enough water, while they are still blossoming,
Those who do not pay attention to what God says are like those reeds;
The things they confidently expect to happen do not happen;
If they lean against a house (OR, trust in their wealth; OR, lean on a spider web), it does not ◄endure/protect them► [LIT];
Godless people are like plants [MET] that are watered before the sun rises;
The roots of those plants twist around piles of stones
But if those plants are pulled out,
Truly, evil people [MET] are not joyful [IRO] for a long time;
:So, I tell you, Job, God will not reject you if you are truly godly/righteous,
He will enable you [MTY] to continually laugh
But those who hate you will be very ashamed,
